buyer_option: Google Cloud Billing / Budgets / Recommender / Active Assist
useful_for: Native billing reports alerts recommendations anomaly clues and project or service spend signals
owner_question_before_spend: Do we know the business owner purpose environment rollback owner and customer impact for each recommendation before action?
aics_evidence_role: Convert native Google Cloud recommendations into owner-approved evidence rows with rollback and claim boundaries
stop_rule: Do not delete resize or change services from one alert without owner and rollback approval

buyer_option: Committed use discounts / reservations / commercial commitments
useful_for: Discounting stable Google Cloud usage after baseline and finance review
owner_question_before_spend: Do we have enough stable usage history and finance approval to commit rather than react to one surprise bill?
aics_evidence_role: Separate commitment decisions from immediate waste triage and require measured baseline windows
stop_rule: Do not buy commitments from a single surprise-bill snapshot

buyer_option: FinOps platform or cloud cost observability tool
useful_for: Allocation anomaly detection forecasting showback chargeback and multi-cloud dashboards
owner_question_before_spend: Are labels ownership billing exports and decision rights mature enough for a platform to help instead of adding dashboards?
aics_evidence_role: Define the owner evidence checklist the platform must support before procurement
stop_rule: Do not buy tooling to compensate for missing owners labels or approval rules

useful_for: Architecture review implementation rightsizing migrations query optimization and production changes
owner_question_before_spend: Which actions require qualified Google Cloud engineering review and approved billing or project access?
aics_evidence_role: Package redacted pre-review evidence so specialists see safe scope and blocked claims
stop_rule: Do not share billing access project access secrets invoices exports logs or customer data before scope is approved

useful_for: Budget variance invoice approval committed-use policy renewal and adviser spend approval
owner_question_before_spend: Which cost lines are commercial decisions versus technical decisions?
aics_evidence_role: Map invoice questions to accountable owners and required proof before savings ROI or runway claims
stop_rule: Do not publish savings runway or ROI claims until measured billing periods are reviewed

useful_for: Owner routing rollback gates redacted evidence and buyer-safe next steps
owner_question_before_spend: Can we triage the bill without credentials production exports customer data project IDs logs or unsupported savings claims?
aics_evidence_role: Create the owner-action board shortlist matrix and blocked-claim checklist before tool or adviser spend
stop_rule: Do not present this synthetic asset as Google Cloud partner proof customer proof or savings evidence
